sections.title: More code, same reviewers
body: Assistants produce code faster than people can read it. Review becomes the bottleneck, and what slips past review becomes the next pattern the assistant copies.

sections.title: Fast now, slow later
body: A session that “finishes” but needs correcting has moved work, not done it. Effort spent fixing is the hidden cost of speed.

sections.title: The codebase is the prompt
body: An assistant learns your conventions by reading your code. Clean code produces cleaner suggestions; messy code teaches mess.

sections.title: Pair speed with its quality companion
body: Sensei never shows velocity alone. First-turn resolution is always paired with rework share, so faster never hides more fixing.
